facts.text: Paul Quinn College is the first and only Urban Work College and the only HBCU work college, guaranteeing residential students paid employment and corporate internships of 16 to 20 hours weekly.

sources.title: Paul Quinn College - Let's Connect
sources.quote: Welcome to Paul Quinn College, the first and only Urban Work College and only Historically Black College and University (HBCU) that guarantees all of its residential students paid employment and guaranteed scholarships.

sources.title: Urban Work College - Paul Quinn College
sources.quote: Corporate Work Program students work 16-20 hours per week, totaling 400 hours each academic year. Interns work throughout the Dallas-area in various industries, including non-profit organizations and government agencies.
